description: For up to eight markets, one compact read each, with ready-to-read lines: 1h and 4h trend (with what points against it), RSI, ATR and its percentile, volume against its average, RSI divergence, the nearest support and resistance in ATRs; funding with its 7-day percentile and change; open interest change (Lighter on Robinhood Chain and Binance); Binance order flow (taker buys, CVD, long/short accounts, top traders); the same market on Lighter, Hyperliquid (with its xyz stock perps), Binance and Bybit with funding and price gaps; and the liquidation map (TrueNorth, labelled).
name: market_brief
title: Markets at a glance, across venues
